intro.h2: Someone you can trust with your home
paragraphs: Davis Renovations handles kitchen remodeling in Waterville and the jobs that come with it: new flooring, countertop swaps, bathrooms and carpentry repairs. It is a small, family-operated business run by Mike Davis, and its logo says it plainly: someone you can trust.

Reliability is the topic reviewers mention most. A rental property owner had Mike replace a tub and shower surround and plans to use him again. Another customer liked his work so much that Mike did their upstairs bathroom as well. When one couple was left with a worse tub problem by someone else, Michael came out the same day.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen updates built around what your space needs, from countertop swaps to new flooring through open kitchen and dining areas. The Davis Renovations Facebook page shows several finished kitchens, from white cabinets with a wood-panel island to dark cabinets with white counters.

image.alt: Kitchen with dark espresso cabinets, white countertops, white appliances and light wood-look plank flooring

items.name: Bathrooms and tub surrounds
items.blurb: Tub and shower surround replacements and bathroom updates, including work in rental units. A landlord called the finished bathroom fantastic and the price very fair, and said it was a smooth experience from start to finish.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a modest bathroom in a central Maine home with a new white alcove tub and a clean white shower surround with a built-in shelf, chrome fixtures, a simple white vanity, light gray wood-look plank floor and soft natural daylight from a small window. Clean, practical and finished, no clutter. No people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.

items.name: Flooring and countertop swaps
items.blurb: Flooring replacement and countertop swaps that change how a house feels without a full gut. One recent job removed and replaced 1,000 square feet of flooring and swapped out the countertops as part of the same project. Ask Mike which flooring suits the way you use each room.

image.alt: Empty sunroom with a bay of windows and new light wood-look plank flooring

items.name: Carpentry, doors and repairs
items.blurb: Door installation, rot repair and replacement, gutters, and deck scraping and repainting with new lattice. Mike also turned a storage addition into a bedroom, a project he posted on Facebook as one man and 100 hours of work.

image.alt: Finished room with bay windows, gray carpet, wall-mounted TV and wooden armoire

items.title: Reliable, and reviewers say so
items.text: Reliability is the most mentioned topic in Davis Renovations' 20 Google reviews, which average a perfect 5.0. Two reviewers say outright that they will hire Mike again.

items.title: He shows up when it matters
items.text: When another contractor left a couple with a worse tub problem, Michael arrived the same day, listened, and connected them with an associate while staying part of the project.

items.title: Clear communication
items.text: One reviewer described Mike as professional, respectful and clear in his communication throughout the job, and said the door he installed looks great and works perfectly.

items.title: Local and giving back
items.text: Davis Renovations has run a fundraising raffle for local rescues, collecting donations for the Waterville Fire Department, and it thanks the local trades it works with, like SJS Electric.

about.text: Davis Renovations LLC is a small, family-operated carpentry business on Silver St in Waterville, Maine, run by Mike Davis. Its Facebook page sums up the goal as the best quality for an affordable price. Mike works hands-on, and he brings in trusted local trades, such as SJS Electric and Simpsons Propane & AC Service, when a job needs them. In 2026 the family announced a new dream: building tiny homes to help people get ahead of the high cost of living. The motto on the logo is "Someone you can trust."

process.h2: How a job with Davis Renovations works

steps.title: Call any day
steps.text: Call (207) 509-1623 between 7 AM and 7 PM, any day of the week, or send an email with photos.

steps.title: Mike comes out
steps.text: Mike visits, looks at the space and listens. Reviewers say he takes the time to talk things through and offer advice before any work starts.

steps.title: The work gets done
steps.text: Mike does the carpentry himself and brings in trusted local trades, like his electrician, when the job needs them.

steps.title: Final look together
steps.text: Walk through the finished kitchen or bath with Mike and make sure everything looks right and works the way it should.

items.name: Steven M.
items.text:
Thank you, Mike Davis of Davis Renovations LLC, for an excellent job replacing the tub and shower surround in one of my rental properties. He did a great job, the finished bathroom looks fantastic, and the price was very fair. It was a smooth experience from start to finish.

As a rental property owner, it’s important to have contractors you can trust to deliver quality work on time and at a reasonable cost. Mike has earned my confidence, and I won’t hesitate to use Davis Renovations LLC again for future projects.

— Steve Moulton
Amber Ridge Properties LLC

items.name: Ihsan A.
items.text: Mike did an excellent job installing the door. His workmanship was high-quality, detail-oriented, and completed efficiently. He was very easy to work with—professional, respectful, and clear in his communication throughout the process. The final result looks great and functions perfectly. I would highly recommend Mike to anyone looking for reliable and skilled work, and I will definitely have him do work for me again.

items.name: Krisann P.
items.text: My husband and I met Michael recently, when a professional we hired to fix our tub, left us with more of a problem than we started with.  My husband found Michael’s business online and called him to see if there was anything he could do to help us.  Michael arrived that very same day and listened compassionately as we talked to him about the stressful experience we had.  He spent a good deal of time with us, offering us advice and a kind ear.  He put us in contact with a business associate of his who could help us with our particular tub problem, assuring us he would stay part of the project to make sure everything went well.  We feel grateful and blessed to have had this positive experience.

service_area.text: Davis Renovations is based on Silver St in Waterville, Maine, the town on its Google profile, and its Facebook page includes a fundraiser for the Waterville Fire Department. If your kitchen, bathroom, flooring or carpentry job is in or near Waterville, call (207) 509-1623 any day of the week to check that your address is in range. Rental property owners are welcome to call too.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Kitchen remodeling, bathrooms and tub and shower surrounds, flooring, countertop swaps and general carpentry. Facebook posts also show door installs, rot repair, gutters, deck scraping and repainting, and a storage addition converted to a bedroom. Davis Renovations has also announced tiny home builds.

Davis Renovations is open every day of the week from 7 AM to 7 PM, so you can call (207) 509-1623 on a weekend too. You can also email Davis.renovations21@gmail.com with photos of the space and a short description of the job you have in mind.

items.q: Do you work on rental properties?
items.a: Yes. A rental property owner hired Mike to replace a tub and shower surround in one of his units. He said the price was very fair, the job was smooth from start to finish, and he will use Davis Renovations again on future projects.

items.q: Who will actually do the work?
items.a: Mike Davis runs this small, family-operated business and does the carpentry himself. When a job needs electrical or heating work he brings in local trades he trusts, and he has thanked SJS Electric and Simpsons Propane & AC Service on past projects.

items.q: Can you help fix a job someone else started?
items.a: Ask. One couple called after another professional left their tub in worse shape. Michael came the same day, listened, gave advice and put them in touch with an associate who could solve that specific problem, while staying involved to make sure it went well.

final_cta.h2: Ready to talk about your kitchen?
final_cta.text: Call Mike any day between 7 AM and 7 PM.
